summary: Sculptor Diversified Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into the MIH Member JV and the MIH JV to acquire the JW Marriott Marco Island Beach Resort. Through its wholly owned subsidiary, it committed $87.0 million for an approximately 33% interest in the MIH Member JV, which holds an 85% interest in the MIH JV that directly acquired the property. The MIH Member JV is managed by the registrant's subsidiary, with distributions proportional to interests. Trinity holds the remaining 15% interest. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The acquisition is structured as a joint venture with affiliated funds. Watch for completion of the property transfer and any potential liquidity events involving MI Fund's interest.
